summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Super Admin Dashboard feature. Backend APIs 100% working (24/24 tests passed). Frontend admin dashboard fully functional with all 6 tabs working correctly. Minor issue: Direct URL navigation to /admin redirects to home due to React state timing issue (works fine via client-side navigation).

integration_issues.issue: Navigating directly to /admin URL (page refresh or direct URL access) redirects to home page. This is because user state is not loaded before route guard evaluates. Works correctly when navigating via client-side link click.
integration_issues.workaround: Navigate to /admin via Dashboard link in navigation after login

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix direct URL navigation to /admin - add loading state or persist user role in localStorage to handle page refresh
critical_code_review_comments: The /admin route guard checks user?.role === 'admin' but user state is null on initial page load before fetchCurrentUser completes. Consider adding a loading state or checking localStorage token role.
seed_data_creation: Test document services created during backend testing, test user created and deleted
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin dashboard feature is fully functional. All 6 tabs working: Overview (stats + recent listings), Listings (CRUD with owner info), Users (CRUD with role badges, admin protected), Chats (expandable conversations), Document Services (status dropdown), Site Settings (form with save). Backend APIs all working with proper 403 access control. Minor issue: direct URL navigation to /admin redirects to home due to React state timing - works fine via client-side navigation.

rca_of_issue.issue: Direct URL navigation to /admin redirects to home
rca_of_issue.root_cause: In App.js, the route guard `user?.role === 'admin'` evaluates before fetchCurrentUser() completes. On page load/refresh, user state is null, so the guard fails and redirects to '/'.
reproduction_steps: 3. Refresh the page or directly enter /admin URL
4. User is redirected to home page
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Navigate to admin dashboard via the Dashboard link in navigation after login. The link correctly routes admin users to /admin.
